title: Sunday Bean Soup
description: A hearty, comforting soup made with steamed beans and simmered with aromatic spices.

ingredients.name: Bean
ingredients.amount: 1 can kidney beans, drained and rinsed

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the diced onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the steamed water and bring to a boil.
Add the kidney beans and reduce heat to low.
Simmer for 20-25 minutes or until the flavors have melded together.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
